name: RC-B10-0114/2026 – After § 8 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
part_text: 8a. Recalls that the Syrian civil war caused a mass exodus of Syrians to neighbouring countries and to Europe; emphasises that the massive arrival of people fleeing Syria continues to systematically destabilise receiving countries and overwhelm social services; notes that migrants entering EU countries illegally has dramatically increased crime and terrorist attacks, including against Christians and churches, the Jewish community, teachers and free speech defenders; calls for the return of Syrian asylum seekers in Europe to be facilitated;
